replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure to understand complex formulas without grasping the underlying concepts makes me feel overwhelmed. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally for checking my work and getting explanations. It helped clarify some confusing topics quickly. However, I sometimes worry about relying too much on it without truly understanding the steps myself.
